intent: generate effect materials from a visual reference
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production transparent VFX atlas for the enemy-freezing effect in a detailed hand-painted side-scrolling arcade game. The reference screenshot shows the current effect that needs replacement: an armed soldier enclosed by a thin cyan rectangle. That rectangle is the problem, not a design to preserve. Generate the ICE EFFECT MATERIALS ONLY. The game will mask the frost to the actual animated character silhouette, so do not paint a person, gun, body outline, box, cage or complete ice statue into the texture.

Composition: square 1024 by 1024 RGBA sprite atlas, four equal 512 by 512 cells arranged in a precise 2 by 2 grid. The grid is invisible, with transparent gutters and no divider lines. All four elements share cold translucent pale cyan ice, desaturated blue refraction, delicate white frost and subtle upper-left highlights. Match richly detailed hand-painted HD arcade pixel sprites, with deliberate crisp clusters and small material facets, not smooth vector art or a plastic 3D render.

TOP LEFT CELL: a broad irregular sheet of thin translucent frost and ice film, almost filling the cell with about 24 pixels of transparent margin. Fine branching fern-like frost, a few uneven hairline crystalline fractures, small chipped facets and cloudy rime concentrated in patches. The center stays visibly translucent, never a solid blue plate. It is a material layer to be clipped inside a moving soldier silhouette. Irregular feathered edges, no straight rectangular perimeter. Do not draw a humanoid silhouette in this cell.

TOP RIGHT CELL: one small asymmetric cluster of frozen rime, angular short ice crystals and three to five downward-hanging icicles. Spread it horizontally, about 390 pixels wide and 160 pixels high, in the center of the cell. This will sit at an enemy's shoulders or helmet. Moderately sharp irregular silhouette, dimensional crystal highlights, semi-transparent blue interiors. No huge crown, no snow pile, no long spikes covering the whole character.

BOTTOM LEFT CELL: one low, wide loose cluster of fractured translucent ice crystals and powdery frost at a frozen enemy's boots, about 420 pixels wide and 140 pixels high, centered in the cell. Small shards tilt in varied directions. Thin ground-contact frost fades naturally at the edges. No hard floor plane, no pedestal, no circular UI ring.

BOTTOM RIGHT CELL: five to seven separated tiny ice splinters and a few frost motes, sparsely grouped near the center with generous transparent space between each shard. Restrained scale, crisp pale blue refraction, irregular fragments, no motion blur. These are decorative chips for the freezing and thawing response.

True transparent alpha everywhere outside ice and in the translucent interiors; do not bake a black, white, grey or checkerboard backdrop. Keep every effect inside its own cell and away from the atlas boundaries. No text, letters, labels, numbers, border, UI, glow rectangle, frame, soldier, weapon, landscape or extra objects. One atlas only.
